title: fix(time): first briefs use coach-local days; morning slots keep local hours (HUNT-06-124, T3)
body:
## HUNT-06-124, agent 124 — T3

### B-06-1: the first brief must use the coach's own local day

A newly signed-in Tokyo coach who never opens brief settings receives the 08:00 push in Tokyo, but its “today” brief is generated for yesterday in Los Angeles, with the wrong session/aggregation day. The scheduler already resolves the supplied device zone, then the coach's profile, then Pacific; generation now follows that same order when there is no saved brief preference. An explicitly saved brief zone remains authoritative. [Generator correction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/6d0e1623cd2e04fd6e53a3380339e67caf92fe37/src/coach/brief/coach-brief.service.ts#L741-L776)

### U-06-1: ordinary morning slots after a clock change

On November 1 a coach's saved 08:00 opening can offer an extra 07:00 appointment because the initial UTC estimate still uses daylight time; spring-forward similarly moves normal morning hours. Offset corrections now re-project the corrected instant until it matches the requested wall clock. This is a cheap UX correction, not an immediate October launch blocker: mobile lists only the next 14 days. No new policy for ambiguous repeated-hour appointments. [Booking correction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/6d0e1623cd2e04fd6e53a3380339e67caf92fe37/src/scheduling/slot-computer.service.ts#L134-L165) [Mobile horizon](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/321274f36939e25a2cdf19ec2b840bda4b395967/src/hooks/useCalendar.ts#L93-L113)

### Failing-first evidence

- Tests-only commits: `a2e65bc169fd64551441000bba25933678db4e5d`, then `156ba2413b0b2ab13da45e5e244ebd2ca4d68d4c` clarifies the November example to 08:00 (09:00 is already past the UTC offset switch).
- Exactly one CI lane, original tests against pre-fix source, queued at publication: [red lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37522168542). Never cancelled or re-pushed.
- Local targeted actual-module proof through `heavy.sh`, TypeScript 5.9.3 transpilation with in-memory Prisma reads and no provider calls: old source **3 pass / 6 fail**, fixed source **9 pass / 0 fail**. This is not a Jest/full-suite/typecheck claim.
- Added Jest regressions for listing, authoritative booking rejection, local override hours, spring-forward, supplied/default/saved brief zones. Normal PR CI owns lint, full typecheck and suites.

### Scope

170 changed lines (tests included); four files. No schema, migrations, billing, authorization, API-contract, flags, dashboard, production or build changes. No mobile edit: the existing [mobile #399](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/399) already covers Home's date-only workout completion classification.

Needs the BE lens pair at the exact head and green required CI before any operator merge. Nothing was merged or deployed.
